title: Does Differential Privacy Impact Bias in Pretrained NLP Models?

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring prediction-based bias metrics (Equality of Odds, Demographic Parity, Protected Accuracy) and probability-based metrics (Subgroup AUC, BPSN, BNSP) on toxicity and hate speech detection tasks across gender identity subgroups (male/men, female/women, transgender) for language models fine-tuned with varying differential privacy budgets.

Measuring prediction-based bias metrics (Equality of Odds, Demographic Parity, Protected Accuracy) and probability-based metrics (Subgroup AUC, BPSN, BNSP) on toxicity and hate speech detection tasks across racial identity subgroups (white, black, asian) for language models fine-tuned with varying differential privacy budgets.
